{"search_note":"I did not find direct longitudinal evidence on household mobility, wages adjusted for inflation, learning outcomes, or health outcomes that would prove better life chances for ordinary Egyptians as a group.
The positive evidence is mostly stabilization, targeted social protection, and service-capacity reform.
The negative evidence is more concrete on repression, exclusion, and uneven access, especially for refugees and dissenters.
Net: there is some improvement in policy instruments, but not strong proof that ordinary people, taken broadly, finished 2024 with clearly better life chances than they inherited.","evidence":[{"title":"Arab Republic of Egypt: First and Second Reviews Under the Extended Arrangement","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/04/26/arab-republic-of-egypt-first-and-second-reviews-under-the-extended-arrangement-under-the-548335","summary":"Baseline context: the year began in a hard adjustment environment, not from a clean slate. That matters because any life-chance improvement had to overcome inflation, FX stress, and prior distortions.","question_ids":["6B.10"]},{"title":"Staff and Authorities Reach Agreement on Reviews Under the EFF","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/03/06/pr-2459-egypt-staff-and-authorities-reach-agreement-on-reviews-under-the-eff-arrangement","summary":"The authorities agreed to more social spending for vulnerable groups and a larger cash-transfer package. This supports a limited pro-household improvement claim, though it is still stabilization under external supervision.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.7"]},{"title":"Takaful and Karama results page","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs","summary":"Takaful and Karama was described as institutionalized, well-targeted, and linked to health, education, and women’s empowerment, with a 55 percent benefit increase. This is the strongest positive evidence for better life chances among poorer households.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.7","6B.8","6B.9"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Completes 3rd Review","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24293-egypt-imf-exec-board-completes-3rd-rev-extended-arr-eff","summary":"The IMF said inflation was easing, FX shortages had been eliminated, fiscal targets were being met, and social spending was supposed to be protected. That points to some short-run improvement in household conditions, though still fragile and shock-exposed.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.7"]},{"title":"New World Bank Support to Help Egypt Achieve More Sustainable, Diversified, and Resilient Growth","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/new-world-bank-us-700-million-support-to-help-egypt-achieve-more-sustainable-diversified-resilient-growth","summary":"The package supported lower electricity losses, water and sanitation sustainability, renewables, and stronger SOE governance. Those are meaningful life-chance inputs because they affect service reliability and living costs.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.9"]},{"title":"Technical Assistance Report: Public Investment Management Assessment","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-04-02","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/publications/technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/02/arab-republic-of-egypt-technical-assistance-report-public-investment-management-assessment-547051","summary":"Egypt had already begun improving infrastructure access and public investment management, with Education 2.0 and health rollouts underway. This is process evidence that can support future life chances, but it is not outcome proof.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.9"]},{"title":"Statement of Support to Egypt’s Development and Reform Efforts","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"2024-03-18","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/statement/2024/03/18/world-bank-group-statement-of-support-to-egypt-s-development-and-reform-efforts","summary":"The Bank framed the agenda around inclusive growth, human capital, resilience, and protecting the poorest and most vulnerable. That is a strong intent signal for better life chances, though it is still programmatic rather than a measured outcome.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.5","6B.9"]},{"title":"Launch of the Joint UN Programme under the Joint Platform for Migrants and Refugees in Egypt","publisher":"UNHCR Egypt","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.unhcr.org/eg/news/launch-joint-un-programme-under-joint-platform-migrants-and-refugees-egypt","summary":"Egypt, the UN, and the EU launched a program to support health and education for refugees and migrants in vulnerable situations. This is a real inclusion gain, but narrow and heavily externally supported.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"House of Representatives approves drafted Social Solidarity bill","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-12-01","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/house-of-representatives-approves-drafted-social-solidarity-bill/","summary":"The bill aimed to unify support programs and formalize eligibility for Takaful and Karama. That suggests more rule-based welfare delivery and less ad hoc distribution.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt: authorities halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty documented arrests of protesters, striking workers, and online critics over economic discontent. That suggests the regime responded to hardship with repression rather than a broad improvement in ordinary people’s prospects.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt: more than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-18","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Security forces detained 119 people after protest calls tied to price hikes and power cuts, including incommunicado detention and broad security charges. That undercuts any claim that ordinary people gained more secure or open life chances.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt: New law threatens to reduce access to healthcare for millions","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-new-law-threatens-to-reduce-access-to-healthcare-for-millions/","summary":"Amnesty said Law 87 of 2024 privatized management of public health facilities without price regulation and was rushed through without adequate consultation. That is negative evidence on affordable access, especially for poorer households.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt education restricted for refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees","summary":"HRW found tens of thousands of refugee children out of school because of residency rules, costs, discrimination, and limited free public education. That shows life chances remained sharply uneven for a key vulnerable group.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: Authorities must end campaign of mass arrests and forced returns of Sudanese refugees","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-19","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-authorities-must-end-campaign-of-mass-arrests-and-forced-returns-of-sudanese-refugees/","summary":"Amnesty documented mass arrests, cruel detention conditions, and forced returns of Sudanese refugees without asylum access. This is strong evidence that the state’s treatment of displaced people worsened, not improved, their life chances.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: President al-Sisi must reject new asylum law which violates refugee rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-03","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/egypt-president-al-sisi-must-reject-new-asylum-law-which-violates-refugee-rights/","summary":"Amnesty said the new asylum law lacked due process, restricted rights, and failed to protect education, housing, and social security. Even where formal institutions were created, the rights outcome remained weak for vulnerable people.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt: growth fell to 2.8 percent in FY24","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-04-03","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099759004052420744","summary":"The World Bank said growth fell because real incomes were eroded by macro imbalances and global shocks. That is the clearest macro-level counterweight to any claim that ordinary Egyptians broadly got ahead in 2024.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.7"]}]}
